text: Pruning and watering are fundamental practices in gardening for maintaining healthy plants. Regular watering is essential to keep the soil consistently moist but not waterlogged, ensuring that roots can absorb nutrients and water efficiently. Pruning, on the other hand, involves cutting back overgrown or damaged plant parts to promote growth and enhance the plant’s structural integrity. By doing so, gardeners can control the shape and size of their plants, direct sunlight exposure, and improve air circulation, which are all crucial for photosynthesis and plant health. Proper watering and consistent pruning help ensure plants remain vigorous and disease-resistant, ultimately contributing to a thriving garden.
